WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT a.translink, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY a.translink, tr.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count,
         1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share
  FROM pair_counts
),
kept AS (
  SELECT *,
         AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(record_count) AS average_kept_pair_record_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_kept_pair_share,
       AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_share_excess
FROM kept
WHERE share >= avg_share
GROUP BY tradekind
